_about: Shared settings for every spray page. webhook = Zapier 'Spray sign-offs' catch hook (workflow 01a13bd8-9e9a-7918-98bd-740588f5c438). data_url = the greens dashboard data the spraying dashboard reads. crew = names in the sign-off picker, with Slack IDs so reminders can tag them. post_checks = the post-application checklist; a recipe can add or replace items by id.
post_checks: No mix left standing in the sprayer
Rinse water sprayed back over the treated area
Not down a drain or onto hard surfaces
Filters and nozzles checked and clean
Empty drums triple rinsed, caps off, set aside for drumMUSTER
Gloves, goggles and face shield washed, overalls in the wash
Spray signs stay out until the turf is dry
Batch numbers, start and finish times, weather
